upstreams.action_if_changed: Review release notes, refresh official libraries selectively, rebuild asset indexes and source-manifest hashes, then rerun the full suite.
Diff the identity reference family before refreshing templates; preserve source hashes and rerun template, provenance, semantic, and visual gates.

dated_claims.scope: Customer-owned SAP BTP Cloud Foundry accounts and user-interactive authentication trust configuration; this is not a universal retirement of IdP-initiated SAML in SAP Cloud Identity Services or every SAP SaaS product.
dated_claims.review_trigger: Any diagram or narrative recommends SAML or OIDC for BTP user-interactive authentication.

dated_claims.scope: IAS API v1 decommissioning for the documented SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance user-group synchronization scenario; do not generalize it to every SCIM v1 integration.
dated_claims.review_trigger: Any identity pack mentions IAS API v1, Identity Directory API migration, or the 30 November 2026 date.
